_note: UIWAKE-1022: the Streamlit UI wakes a sleeping or slow API before /ask (vera/ui_wake.py). Liveness bounds, not decision thresholds.
starting_message: Starting the VERA-DAR API… (this can take up to ~3 minutes)
failed_message: The VERA-DAR API did not start in time. Your question is kept above: please click Ask again in a minute or two.
restart_requested_message: A restart of the VERA-DAR API has been requested. Please try again in a few minutes.
_restart_hook_note: Outward action: when the env var is set (owner only; a Render deploy-hook URL, https), a health check that still fails after the whole wake window may POST to it once per cooldown, per UI process, public mode only. Unset = fully off. The URL is read server-side at call time and never shown, logged or stored in session state. Cooldown below 900 s is raised to 900 s in code.
